name: designdrawing-export-kit
description: Local diagram rendering skills for Mermaid and PlantUML.

interface.shortDescription: Mermaid and PlantUML local rendering skills
interface.longDescription: Use mermaid-render to render Mermaid diagrams (.mmd) to SVG/PNG/PDF using a local Chrome/Edge/Chromium browser. Use plantuml-render to render PlantUML diagrams (.puml) to PNG/SVG/PDF/EPS using Java runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use Designdrawing Export Kit to choose Mermaid or PlantUML diagram rendering.
